To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
SIZ1 and/or SIZ2 are required for sumoylation of Top2p at its C-terminal domain, which is required for proper segregation of minichromosomes and dicentric chromosomes in yeast cells.
Smt3–E3 controls chromosome segregation through sumoylation of Top2p and that sumoylated Top2p is targeted to centromeres.
Siz1p and SIZ2 control of chromosome transmission fidelity is mediated by sumoylation of Top2p.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of the Smt3p (SUMO)-protein conjugation system in chromosome transmission fidelity.
the identification of a new SUMO target, Top2p, and its functional role in chromosome segregation.
the identification of a new role of Smt3p, the budding yeast SUMO protein.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
sumoylation of Top2p by SIZ1 and 2 is essential to prevent dicentric chromosomes from segregating improperly in mitosis.
sumoylation is a key regulator of Top2p activity and that this regulation is important for chromosome segregation fidelity.
the SIZ1/SIZ 2 gene products are required for the sumoylation of Top2p and that sumoylation of the latter is a key step in the maintenance of chromosome transmission fidelity in budding yeast.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the sumoylation of Top2p is a signal for its localization and function in the maintenance of the centromere structure.
sumoylation by the Smt3p E3 ligase, mediated through Top2p, is required for the segregation of chromosomes.
Smt3p sumoylation is a key event in chromosome transmission fidelity and that Top2p sumolyation is a key event of Smt3p-mediated chromosome transmission fidelity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the sumoylation machinery has a positive role for the fidelity of chromosome transmission in mitosis.
Smt3p-conjugation of Top2p is a positive regulator of chromosome transmission fidelity.
sumoylation of a single protein can have a profound effect on a complex biological process.
